name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: B2B Software Account Executive | Consultative Selling & Quota Attainment
summary: B2B software Account Executive with a track record of exceeding quota and building consultative relationships with technical and business executives. Ranked top three in sales on a team of 8 to 15 reps at Accelo while quota roughly doubled, closing complex CRM and project-management software deals and advising C-suite executives on operational system design. Comfortable managing a full sales cycle in Salesforce, from qualifying inbound leads through negotiation and close.

experience.title: Founder & Strategic / Marketing Operations Lead
bullets: Own the primary strategic relationship for a portfolio of service-based businesses, running discovery to surface client goals, objectives, and market challenges.
Identify strategic opportunities to expand retainer scope, recommending and scoping complementary services aligned with client objectives.

experience.title: Channel Partnerships & Customer Onboarding
bullets: Onboarded and managed 15-20 reseller partners (deal sizes ~$10K-$45K), retaining all but one (~94% retention) during tenure.

experience.title: Account Executive / Sales Operations
bullets: Closed 6 new-client deals during tenure, averaging ~$22K each (several exceeding $25K), roughly $130K+ in total bookings.

experience.title: Account Manager, Onboarding Launch Specialist & Team Lead
bullets: Onboarded and launched 25+ clients per month, holding 120% of sales targets and 110% of implementation targets.

experience.title: Account Executive
bullets: Ranked top three in sales on a team of 8 to 15 reps for effectively the full tenure, holding that ranking while quota roughly doubled over the period.
Sold and scoped complex CRM and project-management software to agencies and professional-services firms, with deep fluency in sales enablement, contact management, and pipeline automation.
Guided client onboarding, workflow design, and API integrations, building relationships with C-suite executives as a trusted advisor on operational system design.
Advised clients on CRM adoption, building scalable operational systems aligned to their growth stage and team structure.
